details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:50, 2516-2532 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new verify_merge_blocked step sends its Telegram alert only when ALERT_MSG_LEVEL is DEBUG, WARNING or ERROR, but the workflow-level default is 'SILENT' (line 50) and the step env block (2505-2509) does not override it, so by default the alert is never sent.
  WHY: In consumers without vars.ALERT_MSG_LEVEL (including the stalled btc_sweeper and atlas-bridge.gd repos), the job fails but no alert is sent, so the "alert" half of issue #9483 fix 2 does nothing; all reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2209-2220 (with scripts/review_head_gate.sh:191-195 and scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:245-248) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: review_head_gate_updater_exempt is called only at gate time and on the clean review tail. Gate time is usually before ai-update-workflows/verify and coding-workflows/workflow-integrity have posted. The review_rb_judge.sh updater hold branch (judge_action=updater_verify_hold) exits without calling it, so nothing re-runs the exemption once those statuses turn green.
  WHY: Status events do not retrigger review (ai-review.yml listens to pull_request, schedule and workflow_dispatch, and skips schedule), so ai-review/head-gate stays pending on verified updater PRs. That brings back the btc_sweeper#264 / atlas-bridge.gd#134 stall; all reviewers rated it MAJOR. minimax_minimax-m3 also says the head_gate step short-circuits on pull_request events.
- scripts/review_head_gate.sh:77-174 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The exemption logic (review_head_gate_updater_exempt) runs only at gate time or during the review-tail auto-merge path.
  WHY: If ai-update-workflows/verify and coding-workflows/workflow-integrity turn green after the first gate check, the gate stays pending and blocks auto-merge indefinitely, which is the exact stall reported in #9483 (MAJOR).
- scripts/review_head_gate.sh:review_head_gate_updater_exempt (combined-status jq filter and PR jq filter) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The exemption posts ai-review/head-gate=success with GH_PAT for any same-repo auto/update-workflows-<12 hex> PR whose verify and integrity statuses are success. It checks neither the status creator (.statuses[].creator.login) nor the PR author (.user.login), so anyone with push access can forge both statuses.
  WHY: The late head_gate step (review_autofix.yml line 767) would publish success for an arbitrary diff with no AI review, which bypasses the required merge gate. A later forged integrity success also overrides the real one (MAJOR).
- .github/workflows/audit_consumer_drift.yml:280-283 (also 226-239, 348-349) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The report heading "### Behind stable for 24 hours or more" is hard-coded even though the threshold is set by CONSUMER_PIN_MAX_AGE_SECONDS. The same section also lists pin_unknown and tag_time_unknown entries, which were never measured against any threshold.
  WHY: With a non-default threshold, or with an unknown pin or tag time, the summary and alert give operators a wrong age and cause. Severity is disputed: minimax_minimax-m3 rated it MAJOR and the other four rated it NIT, so the highest rating is used.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:2525-2528 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The Telegram curl call uses -sS without --fail, so HTTP 4xx/5xx responses still exit 0.
  WHY: A rejected alert (401, 429, 400) never reaches the `|| echo "::warning::Telegram send failed"` fallback, so a failed delivery goes unreported; all reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/review_head_gate.sh:167-168 (with review_head_gate_post_status lines 33-38) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: review_head_gate_updater_exempt logs outcome=posted reason=verified and returns 0 every time, because review_head_gate_post_status returns 0 even when the status POST fails.
  WHY: After a failed POST the gate stays pending while the REVIEW_HEAD_GATE mode=updater_exempt log says posted, which misleads anyone diagnosing a stuck gate; all reviewers rated it NIT.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:2513 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The verify_merge_blocked ::error:: message names read:org as a scope GH_PAT might be missing, but fix 1 removed the read:org dependency and `gh pr merge --auto` does not need it.
  WHY: Operators who follow the message will add a scope that does not unblock auto-merge, instead of checking the "Allow auto-merge" setting or the repo scope; all reviewers rated it NIT.
- changelog.d/9483-updater-pr-stall-alarms.md:10 ("Extra API calls per updater-PR review" row) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The changelog says "at most 2" extra API calls per updater-PR review, but a clean review makes up to 5: the gate call does a PR read, a status read and a POST, and the clean-tail call does a status read and a POST.
  WHY: The changelog understates GH_PAT API spend for operators; all reviewers rated it NIT.
- agents.d/9483-updater-pr-stall-alarms.md:9-10 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The canonical REVIEW_HEAD_GATE (agents.md:4177) and UPDATER_PR_VERIFY (agents.md:4405) registry bullets are not updated with the new outcomes (mode=updater_exempt ... outcome=posted|skipped, outcome=merge_blocked reason=auto_merge_failed), because the fragment can only append.
  WHY: Operators and grep-based tooling that rely on the canonical prefix entries will miss the new outcomes; this is documentation drift, and all reviewers rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "When auto-merge cannot be enabled, fail the job loudly and alert, instead of logging a warning." (Issue #9483, fix 2; AD-3: A)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml, step verify_merge_blocked (env block 2505-2509 and the alert-level case at 2516-2531)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The job does fail (exit 1), but the alert is suppressed under the default ALERT_MSG_LEVEL='SILENT' (line 50) and the step env adds no override; the `case "${sync_alert_level^^}" in DEBUG|WARNING|ERROR` falls through to "Alert level SILENT suppresses the merge-blocked alert." and curl is never called; no diff hunk makes the alert fire under the default configuration, and the stalled btc_sweeper / atlas-bridge.gd repos had not set vars.ALERT_MSG_LEVEL.
- requirement: "Exempt update PRs that pass both ai-update-workflows/verify and workflow-integrity from ai-review/head-gate, or have the gate post success for them." (Issue #9483, fix 3; AD-1: A)
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh updater hold branch (lines 2209-2220), or another call that runs after verify and integrity have posted
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The only exemption calls run at gate time, usually before verify has posted, and on the clean review tail; no hunk adds a re-check on the review-blocked path or after the statuses turn green, so on non-clean reviews the gate stays pending.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_head_gate.sh:review_head_gate_updater_exempt, the combined-status jq filter (state_of($v) / state_of($i) on .statuses[] matched by .context only) and the PR jq filter (head.ref, head/base repo, head.sha only) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The exemption posts ai-review/head-gate=success with GH_PAT for any same-repo auto/update-workflows-<12 hex> PR whose head has verify=success and workflow-integrity=success. It checks neither the status creator (.statuses[].creator.login) nor the PR author (.user.login), so anyone with push access can forge both. A later forged integrity success also overrides the real one.
  WHY: The late head_gate step (review_autofix.yml line 767) publishes success for an arbitrary diff with no AI review, which bypasses a required merge gate. Suggested fix: require .user.login to be the GH_PAT account and the verify creator to be github-actions[bot] or that account, otherwise fail closed with reason untrusted_creator.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh lines 2209-2220 (with scripts/review_head_gate.sh review_head_gate_main and scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh lines 238-250) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The updater hold branch (judge_action=updater_verify_hold) never calls review_head_gate_updater_exempt. The only callers are the late head_gate step (review_autofix.yml lines 737-767), which runs at the start of the review before verify and integrity post, and the clean tail (review_enable_auto_merge.sh line 246). Updater PRs are not routed to the workflow-sync skip, which applies only to `pr_head_ref = ai-sync/stable` (review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh line 1006).
  WHY: Commit-status events do not trigger review, so on non-clean updater reviews ai-review/head-gate stays pending even with verify and integrity green, which is the btc_sweeper#264 / atlas-bridge.gd#134 stall. Suggested fix: add a guarded `review_head_gate_updater_exempt ... || true` call before the exit.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:line 50 `ALERT_MSG_LEVEL: ${{ ... || vars.ALERT_MSG_LEVEL || 'SILENT' }}`; verify_merge_blocked line 2516 `sync_alert_level="${ALERT_MSG_LEVEL:-SILENT}"` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The merge-blocked alert is sent only for DEBUG, WARNING or ERROR, the default is SILENT, and the step env does not override it.
  WHY: By default the step takes the suppress branch, so the "alert" half of fix 2 never fires. Suggested fix: add `ALERT_MSG_LEVEL: ${{ vars.ALERT_MSG_LEVEL || 'WARNING' }}` to the step env.
- .github/workflows/audit_consumer_drift.yml:Build report step heading and pin_age_note(); CONSUMER_PIN_MAX_AGE_SECONDS (lines 48 and 105) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The heading hard-codes "24 hours" although the threshold is configurable, and the section also lists pin_unknown and tag_time_unknown entries.
  WHY: With a different threshold, or after a tag-fetch failure, the summary wrongly says consumers have been behind for 24 hours or more.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:verify_merge_blocked ::error:: "GH_PAT is missing scopes (for example read:org or repo)." | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The message names read:org, which fix 1 made unnecessary and which `gh pr merge --auto` does not need.
  WHY: Operators will add a scope that does not unblock auto-merge.
- scripts/review_head_gate.sh:review_head_gate_updater_exempt end; review_head_gate_post_status (lines 33-38) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The exemption logs outcome=posted reason=verified and returns 0 even when the POST fails, or when REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_STATUS_ENABLED is toggled between the checks.
  WHY: The contractual log line contradicts the real gate state.
